scope: Isolated Cocos preview. Dialog refresh at 390 × 844: rules and features for all four modes, account dialogs, legal pages and consent. Bounds are diagnostic; screenshots decide visual quality.

labels.text:
Match at least 3 identical symbols
on a shown payline, starting on
the leftmost reel without a gap.
Each line pays only its highest
valid result. WILD substitutes for
ordinary symbols, never SCATTER
or BONUS.

Three or more minting dies start
the Mint Reserve.

Match identical symbols on 3 or
more consecutive reels from the
leftmost reel. Symbols may be in
any row; every matching
combination is a way. A missing
reel ends the run. WILD
substitutes for ordinary symbols.

A WILD sapphire starts the Facet
Cross.

Each spin opens 2–4 positions on
each of 5 reels. Match the same
symbol on at least 3 consecutive
reels from the leftmost reel, in any
open row. Closed positions never
participate. WILD substitutes for
ordinary symbols.

Three or more Scatters start five
free spins with changing-way wins
.

At least 8 identical ordinary
symbols anywhere on the whole
board win. Symbols do not need
to touch or share a row. All
positions belong to one
board-wide count for each symbol
type.

A WILD crown starts the Crown
Casting.

Collect a reward or play a round.

and unused coins. This action cannot be
undone.

password verifier, avatar and
settings. Play history, virtual wallet,

To sign you in, run fair rounds, keep
your wallet and deliver purchases.
Also to prevent duplicates, provide
support and protect the service.

Use the game only if you meet the
regional minimum age for
simulated gambling and local law
allows access.

Coins are entertainment items with
no cash value. They cannot be
redeemed, transferred, sold or
exchanged for real-world prizes.

Do not buy the same pack again.

Purchases. Keep the Apple receipt
and Player ID when contacting
support.
